project.objective: Identify the parents of Bridget Fallon, born circa 1849 in Ireland, died 1921 in Dubuque County, Iowa

sources.citation: Dubuque County history by Alvina T. Rourke, published 1880 by the Western Historical Society in Chicago; page 512; the book states its source for the Fallon entry as Dubuque County marriage register B, page 140. Viewed on FamilySearch.
sources.notes: Full title on the title page: History of Dubuque County, Iowa. A compiled county history with the author's own analysis; it names its source for the Fallon family entry.

sources.citation: Find A Grave memorial for Bridget Fallon (1849-1921), Calvary Cemetery, Dubuque, Iowa; memorial number 87654321; page created by contributor Mark T. Steward, last modified 3 February 2019; the memorial cites her 1921 obituary in the Dubuque Telegraph-Herald. FindAGrave.com.
sources.notes: Contributor and a stated source of the source are both present in the before-state; the reliability half must be carried in the refined citation.

sources.citation: Iowa death certificate for Bridget Fallon, no. 1921-4407, died 10 June 1921, Dubuque County, Iowa; Iowa Bureau of Vital Statistics; digital image on FamilySearch.
